items.storyText: There is some mud. The mud is sad. A pup digs in the mud. A bug puts a pit in the mud. The sun comes up. It is a bud! Now the mud is happy.
items.why: In “The Mud”, you hear: The sun comes up. The missing word is “sun”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 7, p.71 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text

items.spokenScene: The cub and the pup are friends.
items.storyText: The cub and the pup are friends. They live in a hut. I like to make buns. I like to run for fun! The cub hums and cuts nuts. I like buns, too! Yum!
items.why: In “Friends”, you hear: The cub and the pup are friends. The missing word is “cub”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 8, p.79 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
